changes.new_statement: For drivers eighteen or older, twelve demerit points in twelve months or eighteen in twenty-four months requires a driver-improvement clinic completed within ninety days; missing that deadline causes suspension. Eighteen points in twelve months or twenty-four in twenty-four months instead brings a ninety-day suspension and a required clinic.
